blocks.prompt: 4 (i) Solve the following absolute value quadratic equations and inequalities: \(|x^2 + 1| = 5\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh absolute value equation \(|E| = d\) hai jis mein \(d = 5\) positive hai.
Humein woh tamam real \(x\) find karne hain jo isay sach kar dein.
Plan: \(|E| = 5\) ka matlab hai \(E = 5\) ya \(E = -5\); dono hal karenge aur har root ko asal equation mein rakh kar check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(|x^2 + 1| = 5\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: absolute value ka matlab hai zero se faasla (distance). Zero se 5 ke faasle par sirf do number hain: 5 aur \(-5\). Is liye bars hata kar do cases bante hain.

Do cases mein taqseem karein
\[x^2 + 1 = 5 \quad \text{ya} \quad x^2 + 1 = -5\]
Kyun: bars ke andar wala number ya to 5 hai ya \(-5\), dono ka absolute value 5 hai.

Case 1
\[x^2 = 4\]
\[x = \pm 2\]
Kyun: dono taraf se 1 minus kiya, phir square root liya; square root ke do sign hote hain.

Case 2
\[x^2 = -6\]
Kyun: kisi real number ka square negative nahin ho sakta, is liye is case se koi real root nahin. Asal mein \(x^2 + 1\) hamesha 1 ya us se bara hai, to woh \(-5\) ban hi nahin sakta.
Dhyan dein: is case ko likhna zaroor chahiye aur phir wajah ke saath radd karna chahiye; chup chaap chhor dena adhoora hal samjha jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = \pm 2:\ |4 + 1| = 5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: dono roots asal equation ko poora karte hain, is liye koi extraneous (faltu, jhoota) root nahin. Kitab bhi yahi kehti hai ke absolute value equations mein har jawab ko asal equation mein rakh kar dekhna zaroori hai, kyun ke bars hatane ke baad kabhi kabhi aise roots aa jate hain jo asal sawal ko poora nahin karte.

blocks.prompt: 4 (ii) Solve the following absolute value quadratic equations and inequalities: \(|x^2 + 5x + 4| = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
\(|E| = 0\): sirf aik number aisa hai jis ka absolute value zero ho, aur woh khud zero hai.
Humein woh \(x\) find karne hain jo quadratic ko zero kar dein.
Plan: \(x^2 + 5x + 4 = 0\) ko factorise kar ke hal karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(|x^2 + 5x + 4| = 0\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: \(|E| = 0 \Leftrightarrow E = 0\). Yahan sirf aik case hai, kyun ke \(+0\) aur \(-0\) aik hi cheez hain.

Bars hatayein
\[x^2 + 5x + 4 = 0\]
Kyun: kisi number ka zero se faasla tabhi zero hota hai jab woh number khud zero ho.

Factorise karein
\[x^2 + x + 4x + 4 = 0\]
\[x(x + 1) + 4(x + 1) = 0\]
\[(x + 1)(x + 4) = 0\]
Kyun: aise do number chahiye jin ka product 4 aur sum 5 ho: yeh 1 aur 4 hain. Middle term ko \(x + 4x\) mein tor kar groups banaye.

Hal karein
\[x = -1 \quad \text{ya} \quad x = -4\]
Kyun: do cheezon ka product tabhi zero hota hai jab un mein se koi aik zero ho.

Tasdeeq
\[x = -1:\ |1 - 5 + 4| = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[x = -4:\ |16 - 20 + 4| = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: dono roots asal equation ko poora karte hain.
Dhyan dein: yahan \(\pm 0\) wale do cases banane ki zaroorat nahin; dono aik hi equation dete hain.

blocks.prompt: 4 (iii) Solve the following absolute value quadratic equations and inequalities: \(|x^2 - 6x + 8| = 4\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh absolute value equation \(|E| = 4\) hai.
Humein tamam real \(x\) find karne hain jo isay poora karein.
Plan: \(E = 4\) aur \(E = -4\) alag alag hal karenge (jahan zaroorat ho quadratic formula se), phir tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(|x^2 - 6x + 8| = 4\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: \(|E| = 4 \Rightarrow E = 4\) ya \(E = -4\).

Case 1: \(E = 4\)
\[x^2 - 6x + 8 = 4\]
\[x^2 - 6x + 4 = 0\]
\[x = \dfrac{6 \pm \sqrt{36 - 16}}{2}\]
\[x = \dfrac{6 \pm 2\sqrt{5}}{2} = 3 \pm \sqrt{5}\]
Kyun: \(x^2 - 6x + 4\) poore numbers mein factorise nahin hota (product 4 aur sum \(-6\) wale poore number nahin milte), is liye quadratic formula lagaya: \(a = 1\), \(b = -6\), \(c = 4\). Aur \(\sqrt{20} = \sqrt{4 \cdot 5} = 2\sqrt{5}\).

Case 2: \(E = -4\)
\[x^2 - 6x + 8 = -4\]
\[x^2 - 6x + 12 = 0\]
\[b^2 - 4ac = 36 - 48 = -12 < 0\]
Kyun: discriminant negative ho to koi real root nahin hota, is liye yeh case kuch nahin deta.

Tasdeeq
\[x^2 - 6x + 8 = (x - 3)^2 - 1\]
\[x = 3 \pm \sqrt{5}:\ |5 - 1| = 4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: quadratic ko \((x - 3)^2 - 1\) likhne se check aasaan ho gaya, kyun ke dono roots ke liye \((x - 3)^2 = (\pm\sqrt{5})^2 = 5\) hai. Surds wale roots ko seedha rakh kar hisaab lamba hota; yeh chhota raasta yaad rakhein.

blocks.prompt: 4 (iv) Solve the following absolute value quadratic equations and inequalities: \(|3x^2 - 7x + 2| = x^2 - x + 1\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan absolute value kisi fixed number ke barabar nahin balke \(x\) wali expression ke barabar hai.
Humein tamam \(x\) find karne hain, aur yeh yaqeeni banana hai ke right side negative na ho, kyun ke absolute value kabhi negative ke barabar nahin ho sakti.
Plan: pehle \(x^2 - x + 1\) ka sign dekhenge; phir \(E = \text{RHS}\) aur \(E = -\text{RHS}\) hal karenge; har root check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(|3x^2 - 7x + 2| = x^2 - x + 1\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: \(|E| = R\) aur \(R \ge 0\) ho to \(E = R\) ya \(E = -R\). Jo root \(R\) ko negative bana de woh extraneous hoga.

Right side ka sign
\[x^2 - x + 1 = \left(x - \tfrac{1}{2}\right)^2 + \tfrac{3}{4} > 0\]
Kyun: completing square se pata chala ke right side hamesha positive hai (square jama \(\tfrac{3}{4}\)). Is liye har \(x\) ke liye dono cases jaiz hain aur koi root is wajah se radd nahin hoga.

Case 1: \(E = R\)
\[3x^2 - 7x + 2 = x^2 - x + 1\]
\[2x^2 - 6x + 1 = 0\]
\[x = \dfrac{6 \pm \sqrt{36 - 8}}{4} = \dfrac{6 \pm 2\sqrt{7}}{4}\]
\[x = \dfrac{3 \pm \sqrt{7}}{2}\]
Kyun: saare terms left par laaye, phir quadratic formula \(a = 2\), \(b = -6\), \(c = 1\) ke saath. \(\sqrt{28} = 2\sqrt{7}\), aur ooper neeche 2 se cancel kiya.

Case 2: \(E = -R\)
\[3x^2 - 7x + 2 = -x^2 + x - 1\]
\[4x^2 - 8x + 3 = 0\]
\[(2x - 1)(2x - 3) = 0\]
\[x = \tfrac{1}{2} \quad \text{ya} \quad x = \tfrac{3}{2}\]
Kyun: \(4x^2 - 8x + 3\) ke liye aise do number chahiye jin ka product \(4 \times 3 = 12\) aur sum \(-8\) ho: \(-2\) aur \(-6\).
Dhyan dein: \(-R\) likhte waqt poori expression ka sign badalna hai: \(-(x^2 - x + 1) = -x^2 + x - 1\), sirf pehle term ka nahin.

Tasdeeq
\[x = \tfrac{1}{2}:\ \left|\tfrac{3}{4} - \tfrac{7}{2} + 2\right| = \tfrac{3}{4},\ \tfrac{1}{4} - \tfrac{1}{2} + 1 = \tfrac{3}{4} \;\checkmark\]
\[x = \tfrac{3}{2}:\ \left|\tfrac{27}{4} - \tfrac{21}{2} + 2\right| = \tfrac{7}{4},\ \tfrac{9}{4} - \tfrac{3}{2} + 1 = \tfrac{7}{4} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Case 1 mein left wali expression positive right side ke barabar hai, is liye woh roots khud ba khud sahih hain. Case 2 ke roots ko rakh kar dekha: dono taraf barabar aaya. Is tarah chaaron roots qubool hain.

blocks.prompt: 4 (v) Solve the following absolute value quadratic equations and inequalities: \(|x^2 - 4| < 5\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh \(|E| < d\) qism ki absolute value inequality hai.
Humein \(x\) ka woh interval find karna hai jo isay poora kare.
Plan: \(|E| < d \Leftrightarrow -d < E < d\); dono hisse hal kar ke woh values lenge jo dono ko poora karein (intersection).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(|x^2 - 4| < 5\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: "zero se faasla 5 se kam" ka matlab hai expression \(-5\) aur \(5\) ke darmiyan hai, jaise kisi ghar se 5 km ke andar rehne ka matlab hai dono taraf 5 km ki hadd.

Double inequality likhein
\[-5 < x^2 - 4 < 5\]
\[-1 < x^2 < 9\]
Kyun: teeno hisson mein 4 jama kiya. Inequality mein har hisse par aik hi kaam karna zaroori hai.

Baayan hissa
\[x^2 > -1\]
Kyun: square kabhi negative nahin hota, is liye yeh har real \(x\) ke liye sach hai. Matlab yeh hissa koi pabandi nahin lagata; asal faisla daayen hisse se hoga.

Daayan hissa
\[x^2 < 9 \Rightarrow (x + 3)(x - 3) < 0\]
\[-3 < x < 3\]
Kyun: parabola \(y = x^2 - 9\) apne roots \(-3\) aur \(3\) ke darmiyan x-axis ke neeche hota hai. Inequality sakht (\(<\)) hai, is liye kinare shamil nahin.
Dhyan dein: \(x^2 < 9\) se sirf \(x < 3\) likh dena aam ghalti hai; \(x = -5\) par \(x^2 = 25\) hai jo 9 se kam nahin, is liye neeche ki hadd \(-3\) bhi zaroori hai.

Intersection aur tasdeeq
\[x = 0:\ |0 - 4| = 4 < 5 \;\checkmark\]
\[x = 4:\ |16 - 4| = 12 < 5 \text{ is false}\]
Kyun: "tamam real numbers" aur \((-3, 3)\) ka intersection \((-3, 3)\) hi hai. Andar ka test point kaam karta hai aur bahar ka nahin, jawab pakka hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (vi) Solve the following absolute value quadratic equations and inequalities: \(|x^2 - 3x + 2| > 4\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh \(|E| > d\) qism ki absolute value inequality hai.
Humein tamam \(x\) find karne hain jo isay poora karein.
Plan: \(|E| > d \Leftrightarrow E > d\) ya \(E < -d\); har aik ko hal kar ke union lenge (kyun ke "ya" hai).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(|x^2 - 3x + 2| > 4\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: "zero se faasla 4 se zyada" ka matlab hai expression ya to 4 se ooper hai ya \(-4\) se neeche.

Case 1: \(E > 4\)
\[x^2 - 3x + 2 > 4\]
\[x^2 - 3x - 2 > 0\]
\[\text{roots: } x = \dfrac{3 \pm \sqrt{9 + 8}}{2} = \dfrac{3 \pm \sqrt{17}}{2}\]
Kyun: quadratic formula \(a = 1\), \(b = -3\), \(c = -2\) ke saath. Dhyan rahe \(-4ac = -4(1)(-2) = +8\). Roots taqreeban \(-0.56\) aur \(3.56\) hain.

Case 1 ka sign
\[x < \dfrac{3 - \sqrt{17}}{2} \quad \text{ya} \quad x > \dfrac{3 + \sqrt{17}}{2}\]
Kyun: \(x^2 - 3x - 2\) ooper khulne wala parabola hai, jo apne roots ke bahar positive hota hai.

Case 2: \(E < -4\)
\[x^2 - 3x + 2 < -4\]
\[x^2 - 3x + 6 < 0\]
\[b^2 - 4ac = 9 - 24 = -15 < 0\]
Kyun: discriminant negative aur \(a > 0\) ho to parabola poora x-axis ke ooper hota hai, yani \(x^2 - 3x + 6\) hamesha positive hai aur kabhi \(< 0\) nahin hota. Is case se koi hal nahin.

Union aur tasdeeq
\[x = 4:\ |16 - 12 + 2| = 6 > 4 \;\checkmark\]
\[x = 0:\ |2| = 2 > 4 \text{ is false}\]
Kyun: jawab Case 1 aur khaali Case 2 ka union hai. \(x = 4\) roots ke bahar hai aur kaam karta hai; \(x = 0\) un ke darmiyan hai aur nahin karta.
Dhyan dein: \(|E| > d\) mein "ya" (union) hota hai, aur \(|E| < d\) mein "aur" (intersection). Inhein ulat dena sab se aam ghalti hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (vii) Solve the following absolute value quadratic equations and inequalities: \(|x^2 - 5x + 6| \le x + 2\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan \(|E| \le R\) hai jis mein right side \(R = x + 2\) khud \(x\) par munhasir hai.
Humein tamam \(x\) find karne hain; \(\le\) ki wajah se kinare wali values bhi shamil hongi.
Plan: \(-R \le E \le R\) likh kar dono hisse hal karenge aur intersection lenge; saath yaad rakhenge ke \(R \ge 0\) zaroori hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(|x^2 - 5x + 6| \le x + 2\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: \(|E| \le R \Leftrightarrow -R \le E \le R\). Yeh khud hi \(R \ge 0\) ki shart laga deta hai, kyun ke \(-R \le R\) tabhi mumkin hai jab \(R \ge 0\) ho.

Double inequality likhein
\[-(x + 2) \le x^2 - 5x + 6 \le x + 2\]
Kyun: "zero se faasla zyada se zyada \(x + 2\)".

Daayan hissa
\[x^2 - 6x + 4 \le 0\]
\[\text{roots: } x = 3 \pm \sqrt{5}\]
\[3 - \sqrt{5} \le x \le 3 + \sqrt{5}\]
Kyun: \(x + 2\) ko left par laaye; roots quadratic formula se (\(\sqrt{20} = 2\sqrt{5}\)). Ooper khulne wala parabola apne roots ke darmiyan \(\le 0\) hota hai, aur \(\le\) ki wajah se roots bhi shamil.

Baayan hissa
\[x^2 - 5x + 6 \ge -x - 2\]
\[x^2 - 4x + 8 \ge 0\]
\[(x - 2)^2 + 4 \ge 0\]
Kyun: square jama 4 hamesha positive hai, is liye yeh har real \(x\) ke liye sach hai aur kuch bhi khaarij nahin karta.

Intersection aur shart \(x + 2 \ge 0\)
\[[3 - \sqrt{5},\ 3 + \sqrt{5}] \approx [0.76,\ 5.24]\]
Kyun: in tamam \(x\) ke liye \(x + 2 > 0\) hai, is liye shart bhi poori hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 3:\ |9 - 15 + 6| = 0 \le 5 \;\checkmark\]
\[x = 3 + \sqrt{5}:\ |E| = x + 2 \text{ (equality)} \;\checkmark\]
\[x = 6:\ |36 - 30 + 6| = 12 \le 8 \text{ is false}\]
Kyun: kinaron par daayan hissa barabari (equality) ban jata hai, jo \(\le\) mein jaiz hai; is liye square brackets. Bahar ka point nakaam hota hai.
Dhyan dein: \(<\) aur \(\le\) ka farq bracket mein dikhana zaroori hai: \(<\) par gol bracket, \(\le\) par square bracket.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key (safha 296) mein Q4 (vii) ka jawab khula (open) interval \((-\sqrt{5} + 3,\ \sqrt{5} + 3)\) diya gaya hai. Inequality \(\le\) hai, aur \(x = 3 \pm \sqrt{5}\) par dono taraf barabar hain, is liye kinare bhi hal mein shamil hain: sahih jawab band (closed) interval \([3 - \sqrt{5},\ 3 + \sqrt{5}]\) hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (viii) Solve the following absolute value quadratic equations and inequalities: \(|2x^2 - 3x - 5| < 4\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh absolute value inequality \(|E| < 4\) hai.
Humein tamam \(x\) find karne hain; jawab do alag tukron mein bhi ho sakta hai.
Plan: \(-4 < E < 4\); dono hisse hal karenge (aik factorise hota hai, doosre ke liye formula) aur number line par intersection lenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(|2x^2 - 3x - 5| < 4\).
Humein find karna hai: solution set.
Tareeqa: \(|E| < 4 \Leftrightarrow -4 < E < 4\); dono hisse aik saath sach hone chahiye, is liye intersection.

Daayan hissa
\[2x^2 - 3x - 5 < 4\]
\[2x^2 - 3x - 9 < 0\]
\[(2x + 3)(x - 3) < 0\]
\[-\tfrac{3}{2} < x < 3\]
Kyun: \(2x^2 - 3x - 9\) ke liye aise do number chahiye jin ka product \(2 \times (-9) = -18\) aur sum \(-3\) ho: \(-6\) aur \(3\). Ooper khulne wala parabola roots ke darmiyan negative hota hai.

Baayan hissa
\[2x^2 - 3x - 5 > -4\]
\[2x^2 - 3x - 1 > 0\]
\[\text{roots: } x = \dfrac{3 \pm \sqrt{9 + 8}}{4} = \dfrac{3 \pm \sqrt{17}}{4}\]
Kyun: yeh factorise nahin hota, is liye quadratic formula \(a = 2\), \(b = -3\), \(c = -1\) se roots nikaale; taqreeban \(-0.28\) aur \(1.78\). Denominator \(2a = 4\) hai, 2 nahin.

Baayan hissa intervals mein
\[x < \dfrac{3 - \sqrt{17}}{4} \quad \text{ya} \quad x > \dfrac{3 + \sqrt{17}}{4}\]
Kyun: ooper khulne wala parabola roots ke bahar positive hota hai.

Number line par intersection
\[-1.5 < -0.28 < 1.78 < 3\]
\[\left(-\tfrac{3}{2},\ \dfrac{3 - \sqrt{17}}{4}\right) \cup \left(\dfrac{3 + \sqrt{17}}{4},\ 3\right)\]
Kyun: chaaron critical numbers ko tarteeb se rakha. Daayan hissa \((-1.5, 3)\) rakhta hai; baayan hissa beech ka tukra \(-0.28\) se \(1.78\) tak nikaal deta hai. Is tarah do tukre bachte hain. Number line kheench kar dekhne se yeh foran samajh aata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = -1:\ |2 + 3 - 5| = 0 < 4 \;\checkmark\]
\[x = 2:\ |8 - 6 - 5| = 3 < 4 \;\checkmark\]
\[x = 0:\ |-5| = 5 < 4 \text{ is false}\]
Kyun: har tukre ka aik point kaam karta hai, aur nikaale gaye beech ke hisse ka point nakaam hota hai. Teeno tests sahih nikle, jawab pakka hai.
